about_the_game:
Welcome, contenders, to Project D5!

 

A brand-new slapstick party-platformer royale set in a weird and wonderful alien galaxy deep in the farthest reaches of space where you compete for fame and glory in the galaxy’s most popular gameshow!

TIME TO STRETCH
Use unique stretchy abilities to overcome obstacles and your rivals! Slingshot yourself vast distances with super-stretchy arms or fling upwards to scale incredible heights, grab your rivals and bounce them out of the arena, or morph into a variety of wild and whacky forms to a leg up on your opposition, all to the delight and adoration of the crowd.

 

LIMBER UP
Compete across 9 hilarious and hazardous events. Race to the finish line through obstacle laden courses avoiding spinning buzzsaw blades, survive the treacherous cube where new hazards are just a rotation way, and form tenuous alliances with your rivals as you try to outscore the opposition in the galaxy’s craziest game of soccer!

 

BOUNCE BACK
Being eliminated doesn’t mean your game is over. Compete in the Bounceback Zone and get reinstated for a second (or third!) chance at victory. You can even get payback after getting knocked out in the final round where a single well-placed shot can flip your rivals’ imminent victory into a crushing defeat!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10/11 - 64 bit
  • Processor: 8th Generation i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10/11 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 - 10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
